title: Food on board. Sails up. Nobody there. ⛵ #shorts
description: True story: on December 5, 1872, sailors found the Mary Celeste drifting near the Azores. Food, water, belongings, all there. Ten people gone. #shorts #truestory #unsolvedmystery #maryceleste #hollowmere

beats.en: True story. 1872. A ship is found drifting in the Atlantic.
beats.es: Historia real. 1872. Un barco aparece a la deriva en el Atlántico.
beats.de: Wahre Geschichte. 1872. Ein Schiff treibt im Atlantik.
beats.fr: Histoire vraie. 1872. Un navire dérive dans l'Atlantique.
beats.it: Storia vera. 1872. Una nave va alla deriva nell'Atlantico.
beats.pt: História real. 1872. Um navio é achado à deriva no Atlântico.

beats.en: Food for six months. Clothes still folded. Sails still up.
beats.es: Comida para seis meses. Ropa doblada. Velas izadas.
beats.de: Essen für sechs Monate. Kleidung gefaltet. Segel gesetzt.
beats.fr: De quoi manger six mois. Habits pliés. Voiles hissées.
beats.it: Cibo per sei mesi. Vestiti piegati. Vele spiegate.
beats.pt: Comida para seis meses. Roupas dobradas. Velas içadas.

beats.en: Ten people had been aboard. Now there was no one.
beats.es: Iban diez personas a bordo. Ahora no había nadie.
beats.de: Zehn Menschen waren an Bord gewesen. Jetzt war niemand da.
beats.fr: Dix personnes étaient à bord. Il n'y avait plus personne.
beats.it: A bordo c'erano dieci persone. Ora non c'era nessuno.
beats.pt: Dez pessoas estavam a bordo. Agora não havia ninguém.

beats.es: Nunca se les volvió a ver.
